reference_sql:
WITH store_days AS (
  -- one row per physical store open on at least one day of 2024: the days from the later of opened_on and 1 January
  -- to the earlier of close_date and 31 December, both days included
  SELECT store_id, store_code,
         date_diff('day', GREATEST(opened_on, DATE '2024-01-01'),
                   LEAST(COALESCE(close_date, DATE '2024-12-31'), DATE '2024-12-31')) + 1 AS open_days
  FROM stores
  WHERE store_type <> 'web'
    AND opened_on <= DATE '2024-12-31'
    AND (close_date IS NULL OR close_date >= DATE '2024-01-01')
),
store_revenue AS (
  -- one row per store with an order in 2024: the net revenue of its lines, on the UTC days of 2024
  SELECT o.store_id, SUM(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price_eur - ol.line_discount_eur) AS net_revenue_eur
  FROM order_lines AS ol
  JOIN orders AS o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
  WHERE o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01 00:00:00'
    AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY o.store_id
)
SELECT d.store_code,
       d.open_days,
       COALESCE(r.net_revenue_eur, 0) AS net_revenue_eur,
       ROUND(COALESCE(r.net_revenue_eur, 0) / d.open_days, 2) AS revenue_per_open_day_eur
FROM store_days AS d
LEFT JOIN store_revenue AS r ON r.store_id = d.store_id
ORDER BY d.store_code

WITH open_days AS (
  -- one row per physical store open on at least one day of 2024: its open days counted on the calendar
  SELECT s.store_id, s.store_code, COUNT(*) AS open_days
  FROM stores AS s
  JOIN calendar AS c
    ON c.cal_date >= s.opened_on
   AND (s.close_date IS NULL OR c.cal_date <= s.close_date)
  WHERE s.store_type <> 'web'
    AND c.cal_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2024-12-31'
  GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_code
),

  FROM order_lines AS ol
  JOIN orders AS o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
  WHERE o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01 00:00:00'
    AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY o.store_id
)
SELECT d.store_code,

       COALESCE(r.net_revenue_eur, 0) AS net_revenue_eur,

WITH physical AS (
  -- one row per physical store: its first and last open day inside 2024
  SELECT store_id, store_code,
         CASE WHEN opened_on > DATE '2024-01-01' THEN opened_on ELSE DATE '2024-01-01' END AS first_day,
         CASE WHEN close_date IS NOT NULL AND close_date < DATE '2024-12-31' THEN close_date ELSE DATE '2024-12-31' END AS last_day
  FROM stores
  WHERE store_type <> 'web'
),
lines_2024 AS (
  -- one row per order line of an order placed on a UTC day of 2024, with its store and its net revenue
  SELECT o.store_id, ol.quantity * ol.unit_price_eur - ol.line_discount_eur AS line_revenue
  FROM orders AS o
  JOIN order_lines AS ol ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE CAST(o.order_ts AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2024-12-31'
)
SELECT p.store_code,
       (p.last_day - p.first_day) + 1 AS open_days,
       COALESCE(SUM(l.line_revenue), 0) AS net_revenue_eur,
       ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(l.line_revenue), 0) / ((p.last_day - p.first_day) + 1), 2) AS revenue_per_open_day_eur
FROM physical AS p
LEFT JOIN lines_2024 AS l ON l.store_id = p.store_id
WHERE p.first_day <= p.last_day
GROUP BY p.store_code, p.first_day, p.last_day
ORDER BY p.store_code

other_way.tradeoff: Counting each store's days on the calendar needs no date arithmetic, but it is right only while the calendar holds every day.

solver.query:
WITH st AS (
  SELECT store_id, store_code,
    date_diff('day', greatest(CAST(opened_on AS DATE), DATE '2024-01-01'), least(coalesce(CAST(close_date AS DATE), DATE '2024-12-31'), DATE '2024-12-31')) + 1 AS open_days
  FROM stores
  WHERE store_type <> 'web' AND CAST(opened_on AS DATE) <= DATE '2024-12-31'
    AND (close_date IS NULL OR CAST(close_date AS DATE) >= DATE '2024-01-01')
), rev AS (
  SELECT o.store_id, sum(l.quantity * l.unit_price_eur - l.line_discount_eur) AS r
  FROM orders o JOIN order_lines l ON l.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01'
  GROUP BY o.store_id
)
SELECT s.store_code, s.open_days, coalesce(r.r, 0) AS net_revenue_eur,
  round(coalesce(r.r, 0) / s.open_days, 2) AS revenue_per_open_day_eur
FROM st s LEFT JOIN rev r ON r.store_id = s.store_id
ORDER BY s.store_code
